entries.clue: Undergarment lending its name to the East End's Sunday clothing market
Coloured glass fused onto metal, as on little boxes and watch dials
Byname of Henry II's youngest son, who inherited no estates at birth
Trader's word for the banknote worth twice a fiver
Tunnelling beetle grub, betrayed by tiny round holes in an old chest
Game for taking which the 1217 forest charter spared life and limb
Like a lot that drew no takers, or shop stock gathering dust on the shelf
Sturdy English timber behind panelled chests and old church pews
Knowingly old-fashioned, like the gear on a vintage stall
Fixed yearly rent of a shire, which clause 25 forbade sheriffs to raise.
